userMessage: Whey is milk-derived. If this is a true milk-protein or casein allergy, please confirm with a clinician before use - we'll route you to a plant-based protein instead. (Lactose intolerance alone is a different, non-allergic issue and does not need medical escalation - whey isolate or plant protein are reasonable alternatives.)

review.note: Split resolved: escalation now requires an explicit milk-protein/casein allergy signal, or a bare "dairy" tag with no accompanying "lactose"/"lactose intolerance" tag (the sample profile in data/tools/samples already uses "lactose" as a distinct tag from "milk"/"dairy"/"casein", which this fix relies on). Lactose intolerance alone no longer triggers a medical escalation - it should route to whey isolate or plant protein instead, which is a substitution/product-selection concern outside this safety record's scope. Reviewed and approved 2026-09-05.
